description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, modular arithmetic, and primality testing, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol. It includes functions for generating safe primes, modular exponentiation, and primality checks using the OpenSSL BN (Big Number) library.

methods.name: trialdiv
methods.description: Performs trial division to check for small prime factors in a BigInteger.

methods.name: sophie_germain
methods.description: Generates a Sophie-Germain prime within a specified range.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Creates a configuration entry with a safe prime and generator.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Creates a configuration entry with a custom safe prime and generator.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file.
